dct_description_sm: "Das Dutte Buch" at top, in gothic script; “cccxcij” in upper left.
Appears in Munster’s Cosmographia, German edition, published between 1544 and 1628.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 145.
Text on verso, entitled: Von dem Teuschen Landt.
